messages:
Ben: Quick sync — Nordport wants a 3-hour POC next Wed. Needs resumable streaming, strict JSON schema output, and a demo tool call to their inventory API. They also returned the security questionnaire asking about mTLS and KMS/BYOK. Can SE confirm feasibility and a hosted vs dedicated cost pointer?
Sam: Feasible. SDKs support SSE/ws resume tokens. For strict JSON use function/schema outputs + client-side validator to avoid parse errors. Tool-call over stream supported — SDK emits tool events separately.
Ben: They expect intermittent connectivity in warehouses, so resume is mandatory. Prefer in-stream tool results to avoid firewall work.
Ivy: Recommend in-stream delivery. Resume flow: server provides resume_token header; client reconnects with x-resume-token. If ordering critical attach seq_id on chunks. Ops can enable mTLS on the demo gateway but needs a 30-60min provisioning window and the client cert bundle. BYOK -> Private deployment with ~4-6 week lead time.
Clara: Trust notes: SOC2 summary available; full pack via trust@redwood.ai. Hosted uses our KMS; BYOK requires Private + legal. Data residency: eu-west-1 available.
Sam: Quick demo estimate: 30 QPS peak, 120 tokens avg, 4h window -> ~51.8M tokens. Hosted is simplest for short runs (rough estimate $90-250 depending on model). Dedicated cheaper at scale but requires monthly commit. I'll send a 1-pager.
Ben: Any blockers to call out in the SOW?
Ivy: Blockers: mTLS provisioning window, BYOK lead time, webhook reachability if they change to callbacks, and SSO/IdP mapping if they want RBAC tied to their SAML.
Sam: Action items: Sam -> cost one-pager (ETA EOD); Ivy -> resume snippet + ops steps for mTLS (ETA tomorrow AM); Clara -> SOC2 + cert rotation template (ETA EOD); Ben -> confirm date and share network contact (ETA EOD).
Ben: Thanks team — I'll loop in Nordport and include blockers in the SOW. :thumbsup:
